guidance.title: Application Checklist & Next Steps
guidance.subtitle: Ensure zero rejections by preparing certified documentation before visiting the channel partner
guidance.doc1Desc: Valid Scheduled Caste certificate issued by competent authority (Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate).
guidance.doc2Desc: Annual family income certificate confirming family income is ≤ ₹5,00,000 per annum.
guidance.doc3Desc: Aadhaar linked with mobile and active bank account (DBT enabled).
guidance.doc4Desc: Project summary for business loans outlining machinery, raw material, and expected revenue.
guidance.doc5Desc: Valid quotation from authorized dealers for tools, equipment, or vehicles to be financed.
guidance.doc6Desc: Proof of admission, recognized college brochure, and official fee schedule breakdown.
guidance.docPermitDesc: Commercial transport badge or municipal shop trade establishment license.
guidance.docOfficialDesc: Official certified document required for physical sanction verification by the channel partner.
guidance.handbookDesc: Everything you need to navigate the concessional loan lifecycle—from qualifying criteria and document readiness to physical loan sanction without intermediaries.
guidance.dprHighValueNote: For Term Loans & Capital Projects (> ₹2 Lakh), banks and State Channelising Agencies require a bankable DPR. SchemeBridge provides the standard 3-pillar template:
guidance.dprMicroNote: For Micro Credit & MSY (≤ ₹1.4 Lakh), a complex DPR is waived! A simple self-declaration and vendor invoice quotation suffices for instant sanction.
guidance.dprStep1Desc: Background of applicant, artisanal or technical skill proof, SC caste certificate, and Aadhaar DBT linkage.
guidance.dprStep2Desc: Verified tax invoice quotations from GST-registered vendors for equipment, furniture, electricals, or commercial vehicle.
guidance.dprStep3Desc: Projected monthly sales turnover, raw material expenditure, utility costs, and net monthly surplus for installment repayments.

guidance.applyOnlineNotice: Apply directly on the official government portal
guidance.applyOfflineNotice: This scheme is applied in-person at your nearest channel partner branch.
guidance.tapToToggle: Tap any document to toggle your preparation status
guidance.slipNote: This self-check verification slip is generated for the applicant's personal preparation. Final eligibility, original document verification, and loan sanction are governed solely by the designated Channelising Agency (SCA/Bank). SchemeBridge does not store, transmit, or record any personal identification data or Aadhaar numbers.
guidance.docBankPassbookDesc: Active bank account passbook or statement with account number and IFSC code.
guidance.docLandLease: Land / Shop Lease Deed or Rent Agreement
guidance.docVoctechAdmission: Skill Training Admission Proof / NSQF Certificate
